Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter for non-null EFO identifier and non-null EFO indication label. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return DISTINCT rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
